Search a portable Bank of Japan catalogue snapshot fully offline

Source: R/catalogue.R
search_boj_catalogue_snapshot.Rd

search_boj_catalogue_snapshot() validates the manifest and SHA-256 identity of every referenced raw CSV before scanning the selected files in chunks. It performs no network access, does not consult the live catalogue, and retains at most limit matching rows across all selected databases. Use build_boj_catalogue_snapshot() to create the directory and keep the directory together when moving or archiving it.

Usage

search_boj_catalogue_snapshot(
  snapshot_path,
  query,
  db = NULL,
  language = "both",
  regex = FALSE,
  limit = 100L,
  include_groups = FALSE
)

Arguments

snapshot_path

A non-empty character scalar naming a directory created by build_boj_catalogue_snapshot(). It must contain the manifest and all referenced content-addressed objects.

query

A non-empty character scalar containing literal search text or a regular expression when regex = TRUE.

db

NULL to search every database in the snapshot, or a character vector of known database identifiers to search in that requested order.

language

Search/output language: "both" (default), "en", or "jp". Language-specific output removes the other language's name, unit, category, and notes columns.

regex

Logical scalar; interpret query as a Perl-compatible regular expression when TRUE, otherwise perform a case-insensitive literal match.

limit

Maximum number of matching rows retained across all selected databases (default 100).

include_groups

Logical scalar; include hierarchy rows without a series code when TRUE.

Value

A data frame with zero or more matching metadata rows and a readboj_provenance attribute. With language = "both", columns are db, series_code, name_jp, name_en, unit_jp, unit_en, frequency, category_jp, category_en, layer1–layer5, start_time, end_time, last_update, notes_jp, notes_en, and is_series. The layer columns are integer, last_update is Date, is_series is logical, and text fields are character; language-specific calls omit the four columns for the other language. Rows retain source order within the selected databases and have ordinary NULL row names. Provenance records the normalized snapshot path, manifest SHA-256, source completeness flag, object hashes, query, result limit, and parser schema.

Details

query is a case-insensitive literal by default. With regex = TRUE, it is interpreted as a Perl-compatible regular expression and searched across the series code, names, categories, and notes in the requested language(s). Group headings have an empty series_code; they are excluded unless include_groups = TRUE. The function trusts only the manifest's selected files, so a missing, symlinked, tampered, unsafe, or schema-invalid file is rejected rather than silently skipped.

See also

build_boj_catalogue_snapshot(), boj_metadata(), boj_provenance()

Examples

# Search a packaged synthetic UTF-8 metadata fixture without a network call.
fixture <- system.file("extdata", "metadata-bilingual-utf8.csv", package = "readboj")
snapshot_path <- tempfile("readboj-catalogue-")
object_dir <- file.path(snapshot_path, "objects")
dir.create(object_dir, recursive = TRUE)
object_hash <- digest::digest(file = fixture, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
object_file <- file.path(object_dir, paste0(object_hash, ".csv"))
file.copy(fixture, object_file)
#> [1] TRUE
manifest <- data.frame(
  db = "FM08", language = "en",
  canonical_url = paste0("https://www.stat-search.boj.or.jp/api/v1/getMetadata",
    "?db=FM08&format=csv&lang=en"),
  raw_sha256 = object_hash, bytes = unname(file.info(object_file)$size),
  relative_file = file.path("objects", basename(object_file)),
  complete_within_database = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
saveRDS(list(schema_version = "1", generated_at = "fixture",
  declared_databases = "FM08", complete_declared_surface = FALSE,
  manifest = manifest), file.path(snapshot_path, "manifest.rds"), version = 3)
result <- search_boj_catalogue_snapshot(
  snapshot_path, "Synthetic monthly rate", db = "FM08", language = "en")
stopifnot(identical(result$series_code, "SYNTHM02"))
